sections_target.text: This document outlines the steps of the quarterly inspection of the fire-fighting and cooling system on the diesel tanks.

- The system consists of a foam agent tank with a capacity of 20,000 litres, from which foam paths run to diesel tanks 1 and 2 through the pump installed after the foam tank; the tanks are also cooled by water sprinklers distributed over each tank.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, and reviewed by
Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.

The document was reviewed by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.

rows: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves .....)
Complete tool bag
Cleaning fluids
Check all the main parts of the system.
Make sure the water supply source works well.
Make sure all the gauges are in good condition and read correctly.
Make sure the water supply pressure is suitable for operating the system.
Make sure the foam tank level is suitable.
Make sure all the valves on the foam line are open and in good condition.
Make sure there is no water leakage in the system line.
Make sure the main drain valve works.
Make sure the auxiliary drain valve works.
Make sure all the sprinklers are in good visible condition.
Make sure the fire-fighting system monitoring panel works.
Make sure there are no alarms or problems on the fire system monitoring panel.
Make sure the tank body earthing is sound.
Make sure the lightning arresters are sound.

Introduction
This document outlines the steps of the quarterly inspection of the fire-fighting and cooling system on the diesel tanks.
- The system consists of a foam agent tank with a capacity of 20,000 litres, from which foam paths run to diesel tanks 1 and 2 through the pump installed after the foam tank; the tanks are also cooled by water sprinklers distributed over each tank.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, and reviewed by
Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card. | 
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs. | 
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves .....) |
